dogecoin.text: In no way am I pulling down @dogecoin it will probably do well. However please note the crypto market is a very volatile place. I didn’t do my homework. However I could buy in the future. I’ve also learnt do not put in what you can not afford to lose. This is not advice from me.

At this point I decided to see what I could learn through social media. I saw this post with @elonmusk  mentioning @dogecoin which is a meme coin. With Announcement from someone of his stature you listen. However I rushed in and didn’t do my homework. This is not good practice.

I found that the @Shibtoken was created in August 2020 and modelled off the @dogecoin by an anonymous founder called Ryoshi. It had a market cap of $3 billion and a volume of $450 million. They had plans to create its Own platform shiba swap Which could increase their coin value.
